eleusinian.definition:
a. Pertaining to Eleusis, in Greece, or to secret rites in
   honor of Ceres, there celebrated; as, Eleusinian mysteries or
   festivals.
eleusinian.translation: a. 古代希腊 Eleusis 市的

eleusinians.definition:
plural of Eleusinian
a. Pertaining to Eleusis, in Greece, or to secret rites in
   honor of Ceres, there celebrated; as, Eleusinian mysteries or
   festivals.
eleusinians.translation: (Eleusinian 的复数) adj.古代希腊 Eleusis 市的

eleusis.translation: n. 埃莱夫西斯（希腊神话人物）

eleuthera.translation: [地名] [巴哈马] 伊柳塞拉岛

eleutherodactylus.translation: [网络] 卵齿蟾属；离趾蟾属；蛙类

eleutheromania.definition: n. A mania or frantic zeal for freedom.
eleutheromania.translation: n. 过于醉心自由, 自由狂

eleutheromaniac.translation: n. 过于醉心自由的人
